# Vendored Browser Libraries

These files are packaged with the report service so PDF and Excel exports work on isolated client networks.

- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: jsPDF 2.5.1
- `jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js`: jsPDF-AutoTable 3.8.2
- `exceljs.min.js`: ExcelJS 4.4.0

Source packages are pinned in `package-lock.json`. Corresponding licenses are stored under `vendor/licenses/`.
